name: elagoht/bundle
description: A collage plugin that bundles an application's JavaScript, TypeScript and CSS with esbuild, and serves the output under content-hashed names.

templateFunctions.name: bundle
templateFunctions.doc: The content-hashed URL of a bundle esbuild built: `<script src="{{bundle "app.js"}}" defer>`.

config.description: A collage plugin that bundles an application's JavaScript, TypeScript and CSS with esbuild, and serves the output under content-hashed names.

dir.description: Dir is the directory the sources are in, relative to the working directory: "assets". Required.

entries.description: Entries are the files to bundle, relative to Dir: "app.ts", "app.css". Each is bundled with everything it imports. Required.

minify.description: Minify minifies the output. Default: on, except in development.

prefix.description: Prefix is the URL prefix the output is served under. Default "/_bundle/".

sourcemap.description: Sourcemap writes a source map beside each script and stylesheet, and links it. Default: on in development only.

target.description: Target is the language level the output must run on: "es2018", "es2020", "esnext". Default "esnext", which leaves the syntax as it was written.
